description: This file contains extension methods for IStreamSubscriptionManager, providing various overloads of AddSubscription for different grain key types and a method to retrieve the subscription manager from a stream provider.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionManagerExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IStreamSubscriptionManager to facilitate adding subscriptions with various grain key types and retrieving subscription managers from stream providers.

methods.name: AddSubscription
methods.description: Adds a subscription for a grain implementing IGrainWithGuidKey, using its primary key and optional class name prefix.

methods.name: AddSubscription
methods.description: Adds a subscription for a grain implementing IGrainWithIntegerKey, using its primary key and optional class name prefix.

methods.name: AddSubscription
methods.description: Adds a subscription for a grain implementing IGrainWithStringKey, using its primary key and optional class name prefix.

methods.name: AddSubscription
methods.description: Adds a subscription for a grain implementing IGrainWithGuidCompoundKey, using its primary key, key extension, and optional class name prefix.

methods.name: AddSubscription
methods.description: Adds a subscription for a grain implementing IGrainWithIntegerCompoundKey, using its primary key, key extension, and optional class name prefix.

methods.name: TryGetStreamSubscriptionManager
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the IStreamSubscriptionManager from a given IStreamProvider, returning true if successful.
